confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is sensitive to July demand and to the exact hotel tier. Hostel and 1-star hotel values are close together and could move by roughly 20% either way. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer price. FX: the 0.6955 value and its 15 October 2026 date come from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA; the RBA page itself was not opened or read directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other large Western European capitals and German tourist cities with similar July demand (for example Hamburg, Amsterdam, and Vienna), adjusted to Berlin's somewhat lower restaurant and hotel price levels.
